Current paired wheel samples have p95 16.5ms desktop/16.7ms touch emulation, no >50ms warmed intervals and no longtasks. Touch retains occasional >33ms intervals. isolatedVariants.method: Exactly two browser-injected CSS intervention variants; no website files edited. Same active mobile390x844 touch20down20up protocol, native scroll, warmed fonts and500msidle sampling. Header-relative keeps progress JS; static reveal CSS keeps animation JS but overrides visual opacity/transform. Compare against current control from same-day-ab.json; single-run differences do not alone prove causality. Root/reviewerChromeheld.
isolatedVariants.conclusion: Neither disabling sticky positioning nor forcing static reveal opacity/transform materially changed mobile p95. No dominant cause established; keep bounded implementation rather than speculative compositing changes.
